# Fish N Tingz Bar & Grill

> Family-operated West Indian and Jamaican restaurant and bar in Manchester, Connecticut. This is the official restaurant website: https://www.fishntingz.com/.

## Restaurant facts

- Address: 384 Middle Turnpike W, Manchester, CT 06040, United States.
- Restaurant and table reservations: (860) 730-4440.
- Catering inquiries: (860) 212-3349.
- Cuisine: West Indian, Jamaican, Caribbean and American food, including seafood, oxtail, jerk chicken and Rasta Pasta.
- Regular hours, Eastern Time: Sunday 12 PM–7 PM; Monday–Wednesday closed; Thursday 4 PM–11 PM; Friday 4 PM–1 AM; Saturday 12 PM–2 AM. Friday and Saturday closing times are the following day.
- Sunday brunch is 12–7 PM. Happy hour is Thursday 4–9 PM and Friday 4–11 PM. Check the events page or call for current schedules and specials.
- Ordering is completed through the restaurant's Toast ordering link. Website menu picks are a browsing list, not an order.

## Official pages

- [Home](https://www.fishntingz.com/): restaurant introduction and featured dishes.
- [Food and drinks menu](https://www.fishntingz.com/menu.html): published dishes, descriptions, prices and ordering link. Prices, availability and options can change; confirm with the restaurant.
- [Catering](https://www.fishntingz.com/catering.html): catering menu and phone number. Minimum order serves 40–50 people. Snapper and oxtail are market price; call for a quote.
- [Events](https://www.fishntingz.com/events.html): upcoming restaurant gatherings and clearly labeled past-event photos. Past galleries are not upcoming events.
- [Visit and reserve](https://www.fishntingz.com/contact.html): current hours, directions and table reservation requests.
- [Legacy Events CT venue](https://www.fishntingz.com/venue.html): the separate venue business downstairs from Fish N Tingz, under the same owners. Venue inquiries: (860) 990-4505. Entrance is at the orange awning marked 384E. Fish N Tingz catering is optional.
- [Virtual venue tour](https://www.fishntingz.com/tour.html): 360-degree views of the Legacy Events CT hall and lounge.

## Reservations and deposits

Table forms submit requests; the restaurant must confirm the reservation. Table bookings have a one-hour minimum and two-hour seating limit. Parties of 10 or more require a deposit: $50 for 10 guests, plus $5 for each additional guest. No deposit is required for fewer than 10 guests. After a successful submission, the receipt shows the reservation number, deposit amount and a Cash App link to Fishntingz Bar and Grill, $Fishntingz0 (ending in zero).

Customers must include their reservation number and the name entered on the form in Cash App's payment note. Staff use that same reservation number in their private booking record to match the payment. This website does not automatically verify Cash App payments. A payment does not automatically confirm a table. Every guest must be present within 30 minutes of the reservation time for the deposit to be refunded; restaurant staff handle eligible refunds.

Venue rentals and venue payments are handled by Legacy Events CT separately from restaurant table deposits. Do not use the restaurant table-deposit link as a venue payment instruction.
